data.name: Jalindar
data.gender_notes: Jalindar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jalindar is derived from two Sanskrit words: 'Jal' meaning water and 'Indra' meaning lord. It represents the god of rivers, particularly the god Indra who is believed to control the rains and water resources. The name Jalindar carries the meaning “God of rivers” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jalindar usually hope their child will grow to embody god of rivers and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power and abundance of water.
data.etymology: Jalindar belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of rivers.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jalindar total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: Jalindar is a powerful and unique Hindu name rich with cultural symbolism. In Hindu mythology, water represents cleansing, purification, and life. Indra, the god of rain and thunder, is one of the most important deities in the Vedic pantheon. Indra is invoked to bring about prosperity, success, and protection against harm. Naming a child Jalindar reflects this deep connection and reverence towards the natural elements and the god Indra in Hindu culture.
data.spiritual_significance: Jalindar is not just a name but a spiritual identity that reflects the divine connection between the human self and the divine world. The name invokes the blessings of Lord Indra, who is considered as the giver of life-giving water and the giver of prosperity. It is believed that Jalindar embodies the qualities of strength, courage, and intelligence associated with the god Indra. By carrying this name, an individual is believed to be imbued with divine blessings and protected from harm, ensuring a blessed and prosperous life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Jalindar: God of the river Indus, protector of its people and resources. His name signifies the dynamic and nurturing power of water, essential for life and growth.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Krishna Jalindar in Chennai, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Jalindar, which means "God of rivers". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.
